policy.source_of_truth: This file owns work lifecycle, ordering, authority, and scope across all human and autonomous AI agent sessions. Linked documents own detailed evidence and rationale.
policy.automatic_execution: Only auto_start items at Tier 0-2 with settled local approval may be selected automatically.
policy.production_boundary: Production writes, deployments, migrations, payments, secret changes, and external communications always require explicit owner approval.
policy.agent_registration_requirement: MANDATORY: Every agent session MUST verify or register its work item in /work-items.json with defined write_globs before editing code files, and record verification evidence upon completion.
policy.concurrency_protection: Two concurrent agent sessions MUST NOT claim overlapping write_globs simultaneously.
